title: refactor(ci): consolidate workflows, upgrade actions & node, improve release hygiene
author: Maya Patel
description: Consolidates duplicate GitHub Actions workflows (lint/test/release) into a smaller set of reusable workflows, upgrades node and critical actions to reduce maintenance burden, and tightens release automation hygiene. Motivation: multiple repos and legacy workflows drifting caused duplicated logic and flaky cache behavior; upgrading action pins and Node runtime reduces supply-chain risk and keeps us on supported LTS. This PR is intentionally focused on CI/infra rather than product code. Changes include: - Replace .github/workflows/{lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml} with a single top-level ci.yml that orchestrates reusable workflows under .github/workflows/reusable/*. - Standardize Node runtime to node:20 for tests/builds and update matrix to include coverage for minimal supported versions. - Pin GH Actions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, cache@v3) and add digest-based pinning where available. - Introduce a shared action composite for cache key computation to dedupe logic across repos. - Improve caching semantics: separate build/test caches, make cache keys stable across branches, and add explicit restore/fallback logic. - Harden release pipeline: require a manual approval step for major releases, fix release-drafter template to include commit scopes, and ensure changelog generation runs in a deterministic environment. - Add transient-failure retries to flaky integration steps and increase Jest timeout for known slow suites. - Small hygiene: remove deprecated node14/16 references, consolidate environment variables in workflow_dispatch inputs, and add a checklist for on-call when triggering private deploys. Notes: CI job names changed in a few places; some third-party runners were removed in favor of GH-hosted runners for better cost visibility. This is a squash-and-merge PR.

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Please pin actions by SHA where possible (we should avoid floating tags for critical steps). Also can we keep a short compatibility matrix comment for Node versions?
Maya Patel (author): Responded - pinned actions to recommended minor versions and added note about SHA pinning for actions that publish digests. Added compatibility matrix comment in test.yml.
Sofia Martínez: CI flaked on integration:test in the first run, logs show timeouts against the mock-kv service. Can you add retries and increase timeout?
Maya Patel (author): Added retry logic (3 attempts) for integration:test and increased Jest timeout to 30s for slow suites. Re-ran CI - green.

Ravi Gupta: Approving after verifying release workflow requires manual approval for major bump and release-drafter now includes scopes. Left a minor suggestion to collapse two small steps into one for performance.
Maya Patel (author): Addressed Ravi's suggestion and squashed the steps. Final run passes.
